notes.title: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged – May 17 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support of Blackthorn Arena! We were busy optimizing and producing our other game Age of Reforging: The Freelands, so there was a delay in the update. We apologize for the inconvenience. We will carefully polish and repair Reforged and Blackthorn Arena. Please be patient and give us a good review! Our studio really needs your help and support!

BUG FIXES

 Fixed a rare issue where the game could freeze and go black when ending a round.
 Fixed an issue where the Shapeshifter’s model would not display if a match ended while in transformed state.
 Fixed multiple coin icon display anomalies.
 Fixed an issue in Combat Practice where Gladiators would lose morale upon defeat.
 Fixed an issue where the passive ability of "Flesh Mace" was not working.
 Fixed a discrepancy between the stats and description of the Wasteland Fortress Champion Armor.
 Fixed a loading issue when characters with summons repeatedly entered Combat Practice.
 Fixed several localization text errors.


BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS

  If the player returns Rin to Aoi or Rin is defeated in a duel, Masatora will appear as a Free Champion.
  If the player fails or abandons Gurtos’ Trial, Adrien is guaranteed to appear in one of the arenas.
  Optimization
 Players with the “Shadow of the Hero” DLC will have access to a new starting option: selecting it grants three martial arts manuals at the start.
 Improved sunlight lighting effects in the Wasteland Fortress Arena.
 Optimized character portrait capture effects.
 Pressing ESC will now prioritize closing option or save windows instead of directly opening the ESC menu.


Optimized: 

 Added a new start game option for players who have purchased the Shadow of Wuxia (Martial Arts DLC), which when checked will give them access to three martial arts secrets at the beginning of the game.
 Improved the sun lighting in the Fortress of Desolation arena.
 Improved the effect of character avatar shots.
 The ESC button now prioritizes closing the options window and the archive window instead of dropping out of the ESC menu.


NEW CONTENT

 Added a new Legendary One-Handed Sword that can be obtained from the Weapon Blind Box in the Temple of Gurthos.


Daily Deal Limited-Time Discount Event Incoming

One week only, discounts up to -50%!

    -Start Time: May 18 (Sunday) GMT-7 10:00 (Beijing Time: May 19, 01:00)
    -End Time: May 25 (Sunday) GMT-7 10:00 (Beijing Time: May 26, 01:00)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3168260/_/

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We’ll keep polishing the game—stay tuned for more updates!

—PersonaeGame Studio

notes.title: An Update Plan on Blackthorn Arena and a Milestone for Our Studio
notes.notes:
Dear Blackthorn Arena community,
First and foremost, thank you for your continued passion and patience. We know it’s been a while since our last update, and we want to speak to that directly.

While our development efforts have recently been focused on Age of Reforging: The Freelands, we want to reassure you that Blackthorn Arena: Reforged is not forgotten. We’re actively working on new content, including new enemies, weapons, and fresh arena mechanics, and we’ll have more to share with you soon.

We understand that the lack of communication may have been frustrating, and we sincerely apologize for that. Going forward, we’ll strive to be more transparent about what we’re working on and what you can expect.

Now, a Major Milestone for Our Studio
Today, we're proud to share that Age of Reforging: The Freelands, a sister project built with the same grit and spirit as Blackthorn Arena, has officially launched into version 1.0.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161830/_/

This marks the end of a long journey through Early Access. While it’s not perfect, it’s a project we’ve poured our hearts into. For those curious or interested in our studio’s broader work, here’s a quick look at what’s included in the 1.0 release:


 A massive, handcrafted open world with over 30 regions and multiple biomes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/8c77db5cecab1e46f71da952df83cd97a7e2cf0a.gif

 Overhauled core systems, from stat progression to randomized gear

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/bf3dc55b14242672ad9f0c9c5c46a3b9db9ec81d.gif

 Tons of content, including 2,500+ items, 200+ enemies, 150+ quests, and 700+ NPCs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/b0374f27b4b82f8ccc5e49cac9c5f6628ce75cbd.gif

 A rich narrative, featuring over 800,000 Chinese characters of story content

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/13ec5845e530f671248f27df6a75461a9171a339.gif



We’re continuing to expand The Freelands. Just as importantly, we’re also returning our focus to Blackthorn Arena and the updates still to come.

A Bundle for Our Supporters
We’ve created the Reforgers Bundle on Steam, which includes both Blackthorn Arena and Age of Reforging at a discounted price. It’s a way to thank those who want to explore both worlds we’ve built.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48928/Reforgers_Bundle/

Thank you again for sticking with us. Your feedback, your passion, and your expectations mean everything to us. We’re listening, and we’re building.
With respect,
 The PersonaeGame Studio Team

notes.title: BTAR - v2.6 Update & Martial Arts DLC "Shadow of Wuxia" is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Blackthorn Arena v2.6 Update Patch is Now Live!
With the launch of the brand-new Shadow of Wuxia DLC, Blackthorn Arena Remastered has also received the free v2.6 update!

New Content:

    New Legendary Polearm: Obtainable from the Ultimate Treasure Hunt chest.
    Two New Viking Swords: Available in the Northern Gladiator Arena.
    Cultural System for Characters: Characters generated in the Northern Arena, Ronin Arena, and the new Martial Arts Arena will now better reflect their respective cultural backgrounds.

Gameplay Updates:

General:

    Revamped Knockback Mechanic: Characters who are knocked back will now remain airborne for a longer time, making knockback effects more pronounced.
    Improved Weapon Power Mechanics: When an attack’s force greatly exceeds a character’s weight, they will now be pushed back accordingly.

UI Improvements:

    Enhanced crafting system UI for a more intuitive experience.
    Improved portrait capture for better character visuals.

Bug Fixes:

System:
    Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck if you lost in the Supreme Fighting Beast Showdown.
    Fixed an issue where knockback effects were not applied correctly.
    Resolved a black screen bug that could occur in certain expedition missions.
    Fixed a potential black screen issue when progressing through turns.
    Corrected a bug where crafting profession outfits did not properly reduce crafting costs.

Balance Adjustments:

General:

    The maximum physical resistance for characters has been lowered to 80%.

Equipment:

    Polearms have been adjusted to deal both slashing and piercing damage.

Martial Arts DLC "Shadow of Wuxia" is Now Available!
Alongside this major update, we are thrilled to introduce the brand-new Martial Arts DLC, Shadow of Wuxia!
This expansion combines gladiatorial combat with authentic martial arts action, offering a completely new combat experience:

    Martial Arts Arena – Battle in the bamboo forest dueling ground, a unique stage filled with Eastern aesthetics!
    Exclusive Weapons & Gear – Wield traditional martial arts weapons and fight for survival in intense gladiatorial battles.
    New Combat Style – Master agile dodging, fluid combos, and precise strikes, bringing martial arts duels to life!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557410/_/

We Want Your Feedback!
Your suggestions and feedback directly shape the improvements we make! Please continue to share your experiences and thoughts to help us further refine the game and deliver the best gladiatorial adventure possible.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the battles!
— Blackthorn Arena Development Team

notes.title: 2025 New Year’s Greeting and Future Update Plan | Blackthorn Arena: Reforged
notes.notes:
Dear Arena Masters,

As the new year approaches, our entire development team would like to extend our sincerest wishes to every player: Happy New Year and may all your wishes come true! Thank you for your support and attention to Blackthorn Arena: Reforged over the past year. Whether through purchasing the game, participating in the experience, or providing valuable feedback, every bit of support from you has given us tremendous motivation.

Looking back at 2024, it has been a fulfilling yet challenging year. Since the game's release, we have encountered various obstacles and breakthroughs, and we’ve seen countless players fighting valiantly in the arena. These experiences have brought both moments of joy and the pressure to improve. We have listened carefully to every piece of player feedback, striving to make the game better. Although the game still has some imperfections, occasional stubborn bugs, and there is much room for optimization, please trust that we are committed to continuous improvement to provide a better experience for everyone.

In the new year, we have developed a detailed update plan for Blackthorn Arena: Reforged, and we’d like to share some of the upcoming content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/6f562a5336ce2c83ad120c1d0b14d5d1383000b0.jpg

1. Wuxia DLC (Expected Mid-February 2025)

We will be releasing the Wuxia DLC in February, which will bring a whole new Chinese-themed content to the game. Players will experience a completely different combat style with the unique charm of classical martial arts.

DLC Highlights include:


     Chinese-style Arenas: Newly designed battlefields with a strong Eastern Wuxia atmosphere.
     New Armor and Attire: Brand new Wuxia-themed gear, allowing your gladiator to have a unique look.
     New Weapons and Legendary Weapons: Classic weapons like swords, sabers, and spears, along with some legendary weapons that bring more strategic depth to combat.
     Legendary Characters and Martial Arts Schools: New legendary characters and exclusive martial arts schools, offering varied combat styles and fresh gameplay experiences.


2. Mid-Year Regular Updates

In the first half of 2025, we will continue to roll out regular updates to keep the game feeling fresh and continually optimize the player experience.

Update Content includes:


     New DLC Outfits and Legendary Weapons: Expanding character customization and weapon options.
     Bug Fixes and Balance Changes: Further optimization of game performance and combat balance based on player feedback.
     Free Regular Community Updates: To give back to the community, we will continue to release free content updates, adding new challenges and features.


3. Dwarves and Elves DLC (Expected Second half of 2025)

Later in the year, we will introduce the Dwarves and Elves DLC, injecting more fantasy elements into the game and further expanding both the combat and narrative depth.

DLC Highlights include:


     New Arenas: Unique arenas designed to fit the terrain of Dwarves and Elves, offering a different battle experience.
     New Weapons and Armor: Dwarven heavy weapons and Elven bows, adding even more variety to combat strategies.
     Legendary Characters and Legendary Weapons: New legendary characters and weapons to further enrich the game’s character roster and battle complexity.
     Free Regular Community Updates: We will continue to release free updates to enhance game playability and player interaction.


Spring Festival Discount Event

To show our gratitude for your continued support, we will be launching a Spring Festival discount event, making Blackthorn Arena: Reforged available to more players at an affordable price. The discount event will start on January 27th and run until February 10th. Don't miss this opportunity to dive into the arena!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/cbde4c138fd4eddddaae8c68cfbde433f56cbf3c.png

Gratitude and Outlook

Once again, we would like to thank all our players for their support and patience over the past year. Your feedback and suggestions are the driving force behind our continuous progress. With your companionship, we are able to keep improving the game and expanding its content. Looking ahead to 2025, we will remain focused on optimizing and innovating the game, delivering more content and updates that align with your expectations.

We promise that in the new year, we will continue to work hard, pushing the game’s development forward, and providing you with a richer, more stable, and exciting experience. Thank you for your ongoing trust and support, and together, we will continue our journey through the arena!

Wishing you all a Happy New Year, may your wishes come true, and may your gameplay be enjoyable!

— Blackthorn Arena: Reforged Development Team

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged V 2.5 Update Patch (Merry Christmas week!)
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays, Gladiators! 
           This festive season, we bring you new challenges, powerful gladiators, and legendary treasures to make your battles even more exciting. Thank you for being part of our community—may your arena victories be as joyful as the holiday cheer!  Although it is currently very difficult time for Indie game studios to operate, we will remain true to our original aspiration and bring you a better gaming experience. Not only Blackthorn Arena, but also another game developed by our studio, Age of Reforging: The Freelands, will also be launching a huge free update during the Christmas week! The update will be on sale for a limited time together with Blackthorn Arena during Winter Sale!

Blackthorn Arena: Reforged V 2.5 Update Patch

New Content:

 *Gortus' Endless Trials has added a mode that challenges the gladiator. In this mode, players will face at least 10 gladiators in each wave and ultimately face at least one champion from other arenas. Each wave of enemies will be enhanced. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/eb76721e9295300616799310a04c5a1f3e4c155d.png
 A new powerful gladiator, the Swan Knight Adelaide, has been added.
 A new suit of magical armor has been added to the random equipment treasure chest in the Gortus' Shrine.
 A new legendary shield has been added, which can be obtained through the extremely difficult(RED) treasure hunt.
 Six new Life Profession Sets have been added, which enhance the effects of your character's profession. They are:
[olist]
 Drillmaster Set: Increases the experience gained from training.
 Doctor Set: Increases the health recovered from healing.
 Torturer Set: Increases the loyalty gained from torturing.
 Blacksmith Set: Reduces the money spent when crafting weapons and equipment.
 Cook's Set: Reduces the cost of cooking food.
 Herbalist's Set: Reduces the cost of crafting potions.
[/olist]
You can obtain these sets from the Wandering Merchant and the Robbing Caravan quests.


Improvements
- *Japanese localization text has been updated and added (Localization for other languages are also Preparing).
- *Some optimizations have been made to the running efficiency of the game, which may increase the frame rate for some players.
UI:

 Added a function to buy multiple items at once with one click.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/d416f4e595019157e4a081784da41f4aae4f8292.png
 Added the function of automatically assigning free personnel to the training ground, Treatment Room, and torture chamber.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/84e9f02ee2082ff160655cc8b7f423b90dfdf3ce.png
 Participating in a competition will no longer automatically assign players, but it can be done automatically via a button in the lower left corner.
 Now viewing a competition that has already started, you can see the specific participating NPCs.

Scenes:

 Improved the lighting effects in some scenes.


Bug Fixes:
System:

  Fixed an issue where players can watch matches held in other arenas through the arena list while they have put aside event and storyline matches, thus missing the event and storyline matches they have put aside.
  Fixed an issue where duplicate characters may be generated after the Freeman Champion escapes from the player's Arena.
 Fixed the problem where the poisoning effect of a poisoned weapon did not cause additional damage when stacked.
 Fixed the problem where the achievements Dragon Slayer, Enlightened Monk, and Watch Your Step could not be unlocked correctly.
 Fixed an issue where the race of a character did not match their appearance, which also caused the character's equipment model not to display.
 Fixed an abnormal force effect after being knocked into the air.
 Through a series of improvements, the problem of characters getting stuck outside the battle area or falling below the terrain has been further avoided.
 

UI:

 Some skill descriptions with incomplete effect descriptions have been completed.
 Fixed the inaccurate and incomplete description of the bonus to the agility attribute.
 Fixed the problem that the input in the input box did not take effect immediately when trading.
 Fixed the problem that the target indicator of the character did not disappear when the pause was cancelled.
 Fixed the incorrect skill description of Yanfan.
 Fixed the incorrect description of LeKha's grasp.

Units:

 Fixed the incorrect weapon type for the Orc Master.

Skills:

 Berserker – Suppress Anger: Fixed the issue where the skill effect did not take effect.


Balancing:
Units:

 Werespider have been moderately strengthened.
 Crocodiles have been significantly weakened.
 Reduces the knockback effect of the scorpion lion skill.

Skills:

 Defender – Intercept: The radius of the taunt has been increased by 1.5 meters from 1 meter, while the knockback effect has been reduced.
 Rogue – Venomous Weapon: It can now be stacked up to 6 times.
 Berserker – Suppress Anger: It now also has the effect of restoring health and ending the berserk 
 Shapeshifter – Howler of Terror: now does not work against large enemies.state.


Join the Discord group!:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/6c271078e10206611717efeb841a32f666c591c1.png

Our team is committed to bringing more fixes, updates, and content to Blackthorn Arena: Reforged! Please remember to leave a review - this helps us out tremendously!

-The Blackthorn Arena: Reforged Team

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged - Supporter Pack and V2.4 Major Update Patch
notes.notes:
Blackthorn Arena V2.4 Major Update Patch

A new Supporter Pack has been released. It contains a wealth of game development materials, such as original soundtracks, arts, world settings, etc. It also includes a set of legendary armour and a legendary weapon, which can be redeemed for Gortus' favour at the Gortus' Shrine. 
The link is as follows:

Blackthorn Arena: Reforged - Supporter Pack

Here’s what’s included:
[olist]
 Full set of Legendary Armour: Equip your gladiator with the Kingdom Glory set
 Unique Legendary Weapon: Equip your gladiator with the Royal Heritage
 16 pages of Concept Art: Gain insight into the artistic process of shaping the game's world and characters.
 17 Pages of Design Concepts: Explore the creative inspirations behind the game's systems and features.
 5 4K Wallpapers: Add an arena atmosphere to your desktop with these 4K wallpapers.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/3c3a3a0b30cd43b214f0402c8b36e6908b662aac.png

We've added a new Steam Trading Cards feature to Blackthorn Arena: Reforged, which allows players to earn Champion's trading Cards as they play through the game! Collect badges, and  backgrounds!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/02e9b38d637788baa7e2be7589d6329b7472c2b3.jpg

New Content:

 Two new champion gladiators have been added: the Free Knight Roland and the Scholar Mage Maggie. They will appear in the game world as leaders of the freeman challengers, and will not join the player's arena, but will become very powerful opponents.
 A new Legendary Staff has been added, which can be found in the treasure hunt quest.
 Added a special effect to Leif's Shield and upgraded it to legendary quality
 Added a Legendary Wand that you can find in the Treasure Hunt quest.


Improvements
Overall:

 The execution of triggers has been significantly optimised, and new event and target types have been added. 
[olist]
 After modifying the trigger content, the check box is no longer automatically unchecked.
 New event: Units enter combat
 New condition: Unit weapon damage type
 New action: Switch weapons
 Condition and action improvements: “Any enemy”, “Any ally” and “Farthest enemy” have been added to condition and action objects.
 Condition improvement: The character has a buff/debuff has been changed to whether the character has a certain type of buff.
 Condition improvement: Added all damage types to the damage type.
 Condition improvement: Added the unarmored type to the unit armor type judgment.
 Action improvement: The action of casting a skill with no target no longer displays the target.
[/olist]
 The number of guards that the player can hire has been increased from 6 to 8.
 The frequency of physics calculations has been increased, making the physics effects appear smoother and less prone to errors.


UI:

 You can now choose custom colours in the character customzation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/85242b80180562f46767053c62c010d1c16cf41c.png
 The display of character portraits has been optimised. Champions now have a distinctive golden background, while non-champions have an orange background after reaching level 25.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/62b9935b9049812bb1930f81b602e4d72b66279e.png
 When viewing a character, you can now clearly see the affinity/reputation level with other characters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/f1b9614eb4182d32a912329d6c5d8b5c2bf67ba0.png
 The display of attribute values has been improved, and now shows up to two decimal places. The colour of the value display has also been modified to make the text easier to read.
 The prompt effects for the six basic attributes have been modified, and some of the value display errors have been fixed.
 The UI display method for the background story of the arena has been fixed, and the font size is now fixed.
 Some quick access buttons for our social media have been added to the main menu.


Scenes:

 Fixed some unreasonable monster configurations in some side quest scenes (e.g. piles of poisonous snakes in a sewer scene).


Other:

 Optimised the special effects of some magic skills.


Bug fixes:
System:

 Fixed the problem of abnormal growth of game saves, now the size of later saves is reduced by about 50%.
 Fixed a series of errors caused by loading an archive in the training ground.
 Fixed a problem that would cause the character to get stuck in repeated casting.
 Fixed a problem where the character would transition too close to the target if unable to attack.
 Fixed some issues that may cause the character to get stuck outside the battle area.
 Fixed an issue where the entered amount would not take effect immediately when hosting a competition.
 Fixed an issue where the character's magic power may drop to a negative value.
 Fixed an issue where gladiators will recover health if they eat automatically in the lobby.
 Fixed an issue where the colours of the character may change automatically when editing the character.
 Fixed the issue where using potions quickly would cause multiple effects.
 Fixed the issue where the player could not capture special champions in an expedition after the number of normal gladiators reached the upper limit.
 Fixed the issue where trigger actions were not executed completely.
 Fixed the issue where characters would not continue fighting after casting an activated skill when attacking scarecrows/poles.
 Fixed an issue where the command prompt line is displayed incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue where the “Enter Battle” event of the trigger did not take effect.
 Fixed an issue where the trigger could cause the character to damage itself under certain settings.
 Fixed the issue where the default value of the trigger action target did not take effect.
 Fixed the issue where the trigger did not work when the trigger condition relationship selected “or” and there was no specific condition.

UI:

 Fixed the problem where Aoi's weapon effects did not display.
 Fixed the bug where the player's team avatar did not display after watching a match.
 Fixed the incorrect avatar of Elva and improved the avatars of some champions.
 Stamina Points are now uniformly abbreviated as ‘SP’ in the text, and no longer as ‘EP’.
 Corrected some incorrect descriptions of skills.
 Fixed some localization errors in the English text.
 Fixed an issue where the character selection UI would cover the character hover hint UI.

Scenes:

 Fixed an issue where the Skeleton Warrior's effect of drilling out of the ground was incorrect.


Equipment:

 Fixed an issue where some equipment did not display effects.
 Fixed an issue where some equipment would block the character when it fell off a dead character.
 Fixed the model of some equipment. 

Skills:

 Fixed the issue where the shield's counterattack did not deal damage.
 Fixed the issue where the AI would not automatically use the commander's rescue skill.


Balancing:
Overall:

 Wearing armour now reduces the character's maximum mana, with different types of armour reducing it to a different extent. 

[olist]
 Light armour: Helmet 5%, Chest 10% , Legs 5% = 20% total
 Medium armour: Helmet 10% , Chest 20% , Legs 10% = 40% total
 Heavy armour: Helmet 15% , Chest 30% ,  Legs 15% = 60% total
[/olist]

 In multi-round matches, the winner of each round now recovers 5% health.


Equipment:

 All one-handed weapons have had their damage increased by 2–2 (in previous versions, one-handed, dual wield and shield characters had significantly lower damage and were noncompetitive compared to two-handed, polearm and ranged characters)
 Adjusted the abnormal movement speed bonus of Whisper of the Wind
 Added attributes to the Assassin's Top Piece
 Adjusted some unique weapons that had an additional damage that did not match the text description.
 Enhanced some of the amulets that can be exchanged at the Gortus' Shrine, and also increased their prices.

Units:

 Adjusted the difficulty of each wave of the Endless Trial of Gortus, and added some new enemy types. To provide players with a more challenging experience later.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/593cf195860d989e733e9d1c9b14e7589bbaccca.png
 The maximum magic of the Werequid has been reduced from 1500 to 1000.
 The Sludge Arrow debuff of the Murloc Archer has been modified to be non-stackable.
 Enhanced the attributes and skills of the Vampire.
 Enhanced the attributes of the Mountain Troll.
 Enhanced the attributes of the Lizardman Warrior.
 Minor balance adjustments to other monsters.
 Slightly increased refresh rate for early, low-level matches


Animations:

 Enchanting and Shield spells have had their cast time increased by 30%.


Skills:

 One-handed weapons – Sidestep attack: Now forces a dodge against all incoming attacks while casting.
 Polearms – Swift thrust: Critical strike chance greatly increased, but damage reduced from 30/40/50% weapon damage every 0.25 seconds to 20/25/30% weapon damage.
 Shield – Shield Counterattack: Trigger chance increased from 10/15/20% to 20/25/30%.
 Rogue – Back Attack: Now forces a dodge during the casting of the spell.
 Duelist – Disarm: Now has a 100% chance to apply the disarm effect on hit.
 Ranger – Slide Strafe: Now forces a dodge during the casting of the spell.
 Ranger – Backflip Shoot: Now fires 4 arrows at once.
 Ice magic – Cold Fury: Damage reduced from 45/60/75 to 30/40/50, but now completely freezes surrounding enemies.
 Air magic – Wind Jump replaced by Levitation: The caster flies into the air for a short time, using the power of the wind to avoid enemy attacks and to cast some spells and attack from a distance.
 The mana cost of all magic shields is reduced. From 1.25/1/0.75 mana per point of damage, it is reduced to 1/0.75/0.5 mana per point of damage, while the damage absorption rate is adjusted from 100% to 75%.

notes.title: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged v 2.3A Update Patch
notes.notes:
Dear Arena Master: 
         Greeting, thank you for your support for the Blackthorn Arena! After we have collected the suggestions and feedback from players in various communities in detail, the 2.3 version update mainly fixes a large number of feedback bugs and improves daily(Quality of Life) functions that meet the needs of players. We hope to provide you with a more complete gaming experience. In the near future, we will provide more game content. We also hope that you can give us a little more time. Thank you again for your support and understanding!



Blackthorn Arena: Reforged v 2.3A Update Patch
Bug fixes:
System:

 *Fixed an issue where the options menu would not work properly if the player's computer System language was Russian.
 *Fixed an issue where some displacement skills could go through the walls of the scene.
 *Fixed an issue where the character would be knocked up(hanging in the air) by an abnormal physics effect when the jump skill was interrupted.
 *Interrupted skills will now enter a 1 second CD to avoid getting stuck in repeated casting.
 Fixed an issue where the Freeman champion Xuefei would not appear.
 Fixed an error where Slora the Carefree would gain an extra level in the first quest of age of magic (DLC content).
 Fixed an issue where the Inborn Healer would not take effect.
 Fixed an issue where the running animation of the YanGuan Sword became a sliding step.
 Fixed some monsters with incorrect or unreasonable loot configuration.
 Fixed an issue where using the Amnesia Potion would cause the passive effects provided by legendary equipment and weapons to become invalid.
 Fixed an issue where the characters created in the Role library were sometimes incorrect.
 Fixed an issue where the burning effect would not disappear.
 Fixed an issue where lipstick and blush could not be saved when editing a character's appearance.


UI:

 Fixed an issue where the blacksmith's level was not displayed correctly at certain resolutions.
 Fixed some missing localisations.


Scenes:

 Fixed an issue where Visual effect in the Desolate Fort was incorrect.


Equipment:

 Fixed an issue where the chest model of the herbalist's robe was not displayed correctly.(DLC Content)


Skills:

 Fixed the issue where the one-handed weapon ‘Dodge Attack’ did not take effect when equipped with a small round shield.
 Fixed the issue where the Marksman's ‘Armor Piercing Arrow’ always critted.
 Fixed the issue where the Ronin's ‘Smoke Bomb’ blinded himself.
 Fixed the incorrect description of the Commander's ‘Condemn’.
 Fixed the Commander's ‘Harasser’ passive skill not taking effect.
 Fixed the incorrect level effect description for the Air magic ‘Air Shield’.
 Fixed the Light magic ‘Sphere of Light’ not healing Life and Stamina.


Balancing:
General:

 Damage taken now also increases the experience gained by the character in the game.
 Slightly increased the probability of the audience demanding the defeated gladiator survives (players were always asked to execute their enemies in the past).
 The price of the Mystery Gift in the Gortus shrine has been increased from 100 to 500, but will no longer offer uncommon quality gears, and the chance of getting other quality equipment has been greatly increased.
 The duration of the ‘light’ and ‘heavy’ statuses has been adjusted, making it easier for both to take effect.
 The number of monsters in the dungeon of the side mission has been balanced to avoid problems such as monsters being too dense and powerful.


Equipment:

 The quality of the Knight's Chainmail has been changed from Common to Rare.
 The quality of the Knight's Plate Mail has been changed to Epic.
 

Units:

 The small stone golem has been slightly strengthened.
 The scorpion lion has been strengthened.
 The minotaur's loot has been increased.


Animations:

 The animation speed of some ranged skills has been slightly increased.


Skills:

 Ranger: Backflip shots now stuns the target for 1 second.
 Defender: Passive damage resistance increased from 3% per level to 2% per level (Defender was too versatile and powerful compared to the other genres).


Improvements
General:

 All types of quests now automatically pick up loot from enemy corpses.
 When a hunting quest ends, the player can now choose whether to kill the main target or not (if they choose not to kill, they will be captured in the Arena).
 The player can now skip the entire execution process with one click.
 Characters will no longer be deactivated by disengaging during side mission and match.
 More instructions have been added to the tutorial for triggers.
 The order of gladiators is now saved after they have been sorted in a specific order.
 There is now a degree of randomness when unlocking recipes.


UI:

 Added hover tips for the genre/class when buying gladiators/slaves in the market.
 You can now press ESC in the market to bring up the setting menu.
 Optimised the descriptions of some items that were too long.
 The effects of injuries can now be seen in the surgery room.
 The descriptions of the removable traits can now be seen in the dark room.
 Optimised the slots in the training ground and torture chamber, which now display the most noteworthy information for the corresponding slot.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/6ce6fbd37f56e0cb3a3a500b68a49f9e9f50c3de.png
 The staff information for each function scene has been optimised, and an experience bar display for relevant professional skills has been added.(DLC Content)
 The hover tooltip for the gladiator's head frame now includes the display of the target's magic types.
 Added the function of selling items of the selected type and quality with one click (Bulk Sale).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/d171292266e66995a704ca479dcab36b186cb3ae.png
 Added the function of random name generation for the role library.




Scenarios:

 Improved the lighting and navigation of some cave quest scenarios.


New content:

 A legendary weapon, Awn of Light, has been added. Players can obtain it by completing high-level dungeon treasure hunts.


Age of Magic DLC:

 1. A new innate trait has been added that allows a non-magical character to pass the magical trials.
 2. An option has been added at the start of the game, so that players can now unlock the functions related to the magic tower at the beginning.


P.S:  We apologise for the many shortcomings in the early days of the game's release, which did not provide the smooth experience for you. We hope you can see our sincerity and the substantial improvements in our recent updates. And now, our studio is in a difficult situation. We sincerely ask for your support. Every positive review you give us can help us tremendously and help the studio survive. We promise to continue updating and improving the game in the future, and we will also create more new content for everyone! Thank you again for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Age of Magic DLC Launches Today + Full Patch Notes for v2.2a Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/cf7237210f0e10793e98c7819725c71452ffa52c.png

Hello, Gladiators!

The time has come! Later today at 6 PM PST / 9 PM EST / 10 AM China, the Age of Magic DLC will officially launch. We know some of you were eagerly awaiting it two hours earlier, and we appreciate your patience as we made final adjustments to bring you the best experience possible. 

With this new DLC, you’ll be able to harness ancient magic, face mythic creatures, and elevate your champions in ways that will change the arena forever. We’re excited to see the unique strategies you’ll unleash with these new powers!

We've got a new Age of Magic DLC trailer as well:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3LLAuLp4EVc

Alongside the DLC launch, we’re also releasing our v2.2a Update Patch, packed with new content, important fixes, and balancing adjustments to make the game even more immersive. 

We owe a big thanks to each of you for your honest reviews and the feedback you’ve shared in our Discord community. Your insights help us keep improving and creating a better experience for everyone.

Blackthorn Arena: Reforged v2.2a Update Patch Notes

New Content

 Five new belts, balanced across all ranks.
 Two powerful new Freeman champions.
 More types of Ventationes added.
 New suffixes and unique growth paths for NPC gladiators.

Bug Fixes

System

 Fixed crashes caused by AI triggers and enemy detection.
 Resolved rare gladiator information error preventing save file loading.
 Fixed import/export of character appearance data.
 Resolved an issue where triggering evasion during "flow slash" could cause the character to get stuck.
 Fixed issue where Leif in the training arena couldn’t progress after losing to Asbjorn.
 Corrected the cancel tournament button availability on the scheduled start day.
 Fixed issues with captured beasts in tournaments.
 Addressed various trigger-related issues, improving functionality.
 Fixed skill description inaccuracies in the shortcut bar.

Equipment

 Resolved display issue with Ylwa's helmet.
 Fixed Asbjorn's armor duration for transformation.
 Corrected display for Xuefei's weapon, Cangfeng.

Skills

 Fixed monk's "Chi Shield" absorption rate.
 Corrected shapeshifter’s "grab attack" knockback distance.
 Adjusted attack speed bonus for berserker’s passive effect.
 Fixed the third attack of the dual wield "Whirlwind" skill and updated description.

Balancing

General

 NPC gladiators now select fighting styles suited to their weapons.
 Balanced rewards for Ventationes and adjusted Rare/Epic item market prices.
 Revised tournament appeal calculation based on reputation.

Character

 Adjusted Orc Master’s size to Large (immune to some controls) and reduced health by 100 points.

Equipment

 Rebalanced armor weight and defense for Asbjorn, Ylwa, and Leif.
 Adjusted defense and weight for all armor.
 Reduced hit penalty for dual weapons from 15 to 10.
 Reduced damage and increased stamina cost for all two-handed weapons.

Animations

 Increased animation speed of Chi Shield by 20%.
 Increased animation speed of Cohesion by 20%.
 Increased Shapeshifter’s transformation speed by 10%.

Skills

 Monk: Increased cooldown of landing attack from 20 to 30 seconds; raised stamina cost; reduced weapon damage.
 Unarmed: Increased stamina cost of Hug Smash; adjusted stun duration.
 One-Handed: Increased Gale Combo damage; extended cooldown.
 Two-Handed: Reduced Lethal strike’s critical bonus.
 Polearms: Increased cooldown and stamina cost for Cutdown.
 Dual Weapons: Increased damage for Feign attack and Serial jabs.
 Duelist: Increased damage of Precision Strike.
 Rogue: Adjusted evasion time; reduced unselectable duration.
 Shapeshifter: Updated Bear form size/controls and Wolf form attack; adjusted Shred damage.

Improvements

Overall

 Added automatic profile file backup to prevent archive corruption.
 Enhanced final boss of the Grand Game for a more challenging encounter.

UI

 Improved Role library’s point-adding interface.

Scenes

 Enhanced Blackthorn Arena environment with deadly steel thorns.
 Adjusted starting positions in the Battle of the Desolate Fort.
 Added boundary air walls to multiple outdoor scenes to indicate movement range.


Thank You for Your Feedback!

This update is a reflection of your support and insights, and we’re truly grateful for each review and comment. Please keep the feedback coming!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172175/6c271078e10206611717efeb841a32f666c591c1.png

Leave us a review, and hop into our Discord server (https://discord.gg/bNnQtBUKXA) to share your thoughts directly. Your feedback helps us make the game the best it can be.

We’re thrilled to see how you’ll wield the new powers and face the challenges awaiting you in the Age of Magic. 

See you in the arena!

- The corresponding tutorial will now pop up the first time the player plays the game
- The default AI of characters will now automatically cast the “Rescue” skill
- The number of champions will now be displayed in addition to the number of gladiators.
- The probability of encountering advanced gladiators with suffixes among NPC gladiators has been reduced on all difficulties.
- The attribute penalties for low health and morale when gladiators go into battle have been reduced.   
- Penalties will only be incurred when the health and morale of gladiators are below 50.

notes.title: November 3rd Hotfix！
notes.notes:
November 3rd Hotfix!

Bugs Fixed:

- Fixed a bug where a new game could not be started because the video could not be decoded.
- Fixed a bug that caused a black screen freeze after entering certain types of dispatch missions.
- Fixed a bug where challenges did not start properly and were archived abnormally after accepting a challenge from Asbjorn the Northerner.
- Fixed a bug where sometimes it was possible to drag and drop a wandering merchant's product and directly obtain the item.
- Fixed a bug where sometimes you cannot disengage from the battle during a dispatch mission.
- Fixed a bug where challenging the second champion of a gladiator arena would not obtain legendary equipment.
- Fixed a bug where broken Blackthorn Armor could not be reforged.
- Fixed a bug where Master Valen and Master Sylmar from the Temple of Izziel would appear before the Spring Game.


Improvements:

Reduces the probability of arguing between gladiators.

Hello, Arena Masters!
